admission.justification: Store gates and the two mutation owners jointly prevent a leaf agent or settings copy from authorizing its own direct publication.

applicability: Prospective direct-leaf admission and product grant mutations.
conditions: The canonical task is a subTask and ordinary unstarted evidence admits the change.
exclusions: Arbitrary shell writes are not prevented.
Already accepted generations retain advertised completion/recovery authority.

evidence: MIK-R94@v1, D63/D74 and canonical Architect amendments

statement: Direct execution is an external canonical-leaf grant read at the call; only the developer dashboard control and launch-bound architect product function mutate it before work starts, and task authoring or a harness setting cannot self-grant.
